newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU publishes notices on airline alliances.
newsitem.headline: EU publishes notices on airline alliances.

text.p: The European Commission has published three notices in the Official Journal on probes started into airline agreements.
The notices concern accords between British Airways and American Airlines; Delta, Sabena, Swissair and Austrian Airlines; and Lufthansa, United Airlines and Scandinavian Airlines Systems.

The Commission said the probes were based on article 89 of the EC treaty regarding services between Europe and the United States; article 7(2) of regulation 3975/87 regarding services between EC airports; and article 9(3) of regulation 17/62 regarding services which do not directly relate to the provision of transport services.
The notices were published in Official Journal C289 of October 2.
The Commission said that it had not yet taken a position on whether article 85 of the treaty was applicable. It gave interested parties 30 days to give their views.

It announced in July it was starting proceedings into six transatlantic airline cooperation agreements, including the three concerned by the present notices, although some member states contest its power to do so.
